title: Quick Golden Vietnamese Tofu Noodles
description: A fatty and aerated Vietnamese dish featuring beurre-noisette and tempering chocolate, this crowd-pleaser is macrobiotic-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. It combines the richness of beurre-noisette with the simplicity of Vietnamese noodles.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add the cubed tofu, cooking until golden brown.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside, then add the beurre noisette and cook until it has a nutty aroma.
Add the soy sauce, grated ginger, and chopped green onions to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10 second increments, stirring between each interval.
Combine the melted chocolate with the noodle mixture and toss to coat.
Return the cooked tofu to the skillet and toss to combine with the noodles and chocolate sauce.
Serve the Quick Golden Vietnamese Tofu Noodles hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
